defects.mechanism: VERL names the socket ipc:///tmp/rl-colocate-zmq-{ray_job_id}-replica-{r}-rank-{k}.sock (receiver instrumented_python_packages/verl/workers/rollout/vllm_rollout/utils.py:415, sender vllm_rollout.py:141). Every fresh Ray cluster starts with the same first job id, and the container sees the node's shared /tmp (apptainer 'mount tmp = yes'). For every weight sync the sender removes an existing socket file and binds a new REQ socket (bucketed_weight_transfer.py:163-172), so a second job on the same node that syncs at the same time takes over the path and the first job's vLLM workers receive the second job's CUDA IPC handles. The handles refer to GPUs that the receiver cannot see, so the receiver fails (CUDA invalid argument) or both senders wait indefinitely. Same defect as MI250X runtime-amendment-01 (paper/submission/ccpe_submission/supporting_information/supplement_mi250x.tex).
defects.summary: Two Slurm jobs on one node exchanged CUDA IPC handles through VERL's colocated weight-transfer socket in the node-shared /tmp.

launcher_fix.change: apptainer exec binds the invocation's own $SCRATCH_RUNTIME/tmp (created with the rest of the runtime and removed with it at exit) onto /tmp: --bind "$CONTAINER_TMP:/tmp". RESUME_FROM_PATH may also lie below $RLVRAM_SCRATCH_ROOT/preserved-checkpoints/. Nothing else changes (TMPDIR stays /r/tmp, which is the same directory). Before the trainer starts, inside the container, a per-invocation token written to $SCRATCH_RUNTIME/tmp/.rlvram-private-tmp must be visible at /tmp/.rlvram-private-tmp; otherwise the invocation stops with exit 97 (infrastructure, unresolved; never a memory outcome) and logs 'RLVRAM_PRIVATE_TMP failed'; on success it logs 'RLVRAM_PRIVATE_TMP verified'. No inherited bind targets /tmp, so the explicit bind is the only user bind of /tmp.
